novel_features.name: New jobs since last run
novel_features.description: Re-run a saved search and show only the postings that appeared since you last looked.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local first_seen_at history per saved search; Indeed exposes no durable cursor for this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to poll a query on a schedule without re-reading jobs you've already triaged.

novel_features.name: Offline full-text search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every job you've ever synced, with no network call.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 over the local store; works offline and across many past searches at once.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you want to grep your whole job history, not just one fresh query.

novel_features.name: Saved searches
novel_features.description: Persist a named query with all its filters so you can re-run it by name.
novel_features.rationale: Local persistence of query + filters; the basis for new-since-last-run.
novel_features.example: indeed-pp-cli saved save daily-remote "software engineer" --location Remote --posted 1 --sort date
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to define the recurring searches you care about once, then poll them.

novel_features.name: Salary floor filter
novel_features.description: Drop results whose parsed salary falls below a threshold.
novel_features.rationale: Requires parsing Indeed's free-text salary snippets locally and filtering on the normalized minimum.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to cut low-paying noise that Indeed's own filters miss because salaries are free-text.

novel_features.name: Multi-location fan-out
novel_features.description: Run one keyword across several locations in a single command and dedup by job key.
novel_features.rationale: Fans out N requests and merges/dedups locally in one pass.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you're open to multiple metros and want one merged, deduped list.

novel_features.name: Track a job
novel_features.description: Add a job to a local shortlist you can list and annotate later.
novel_features.rationale: Local shortlist with status; no Indeed equivalent without a logged-in account.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to keep a working set of interesting jobs across sessions without logging in.

narrative.headline: Search Indeed from your terminal — with a local job history no scraper keeps, so you can ask what's new since last time and grep everything offline.
narrative.value_prop: A read-only job-search CLI for Indeed. Search with all the filters (location, radius, date posted, job type, remote, salary floor), pull full job descriptions, and research companies. Every job you see is stored locally, so `new` shows only fresh postings for a saved search and `find` does offline full-text search across your whole history.

quickstart.comment: full description for a result's key

quickstart.command: indeed-pp-cli saved save daily-remote "software engineer" --location Remote --posted 1
quickstart.comment: name a search to poll later
only what's appeared since last run

troubleshoots.symptom: search returns 0 results but the query is valid
troubleshoots.fix: Indeed may have escalated bot protection on the SERP; retry, and check `indeed-pp-cli doctor` for reachability.

troubleshoots.symptom: salary is empty for many jobs
troubleshoots.fix: Indeed only lists salary on some postings; salary is free-text and absent on most. Use --min-salary to keep only the ones that have it.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when an agent or user needs to search Indeed job listings, pull a full job description by key, research a company's rating/size, or track new postings for a recurring search over time. It is read-only: it never applies to jobs or submits resumes.

recipes.explanation: Use --select to keep only the fields you need from each job and avoid burning context on the full payload.

recipes.explanation: Drop anything under $150k (by parsed salary) and export to CSV.
